profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java · Oracle PL/SQL · Spring Boot · Vue.js · AWS | Manufacturing & Logistics Systems
profile.summary:
Software engineer building and running production systems for automotive manufacturing and logistics.

At Comgen America, I build warehouse and assembly-line systems for Hyundai GLOVIS end to end, from Oracle PL/SQL business logic and Java services to Vue.js screens and production support. Recent work includes a real-time dashboard that shows which parts are arriving late to the assembly line (open late-delivery alerts dropped from 10+ to 0–1), an automated parts-replenishment system that assigns work and prints labels, and a print service that replaced an old print server.

Outside work, I build Jay Asset (asset.jehyeonlee.net), a serverless asset-allocation web app on React, Flask, and AWS.

B.S. Computer Science (Data Science), Brigham Young University. Bilingual in Korean and English.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hyundai GLOVIS — Logistics System Maintenance & Enhancements (Oct 2026 – Present)
• Cut a monitoring server's SQL log volume by ~98% (850 MB → 10 MB/day) and found duplicate background threads adding needless database load.
• Fixed an assembly-line alert email that failed on long messages, so it now lists up to ~383 parts instead of 33.

Hyundai GLOVIS — Warehouse & Assembly-Line Parts Supply Systems (Mar 2026 – Sep 2026)
• Built a real-time dashboard (Vue, JSP, Oracle; desktop and mobile) that shows supervisors which parts are arriving late to the assembly line; open late-delivery alerts typically dropped from 10+ to 0–1.
• Built an automated parts-replenishment system in Oracle PL/SQL that decides which bins to refill first, assigns each task to a worker on the current shift, and prints labels automatically; made data refresh ~3x faster (113s → 39s).
• Built a Spring Boot print service to replace an old print server; it now prints production labels for the replenishment system.
• Built inventory reports combining six data sources (~5,500 parts) and automated a manual Excel check comparing SAP records with the internal logistics system.
• Diagnosed production issues in the Java application server and Oracle database, such as outdated data reads, queries that intermittently returned no rows, and dropped connections.

Hyundai GLOVIS — Logistics System Modernization (Sep 2025 – Feb 2026)
• Rebuilt 36+ legacy logistics screens in Vue.js on the existing Java/JSP and Oracle backend.
• Built a Java background service for Windows that automatically prints Zebra labels and PDF documents.
• Wrote Oracle PL/SQL procedures that build a three-step unloading schedule: order parts by stock level and first-in-first-out, score priority, and assign units.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PL/SQL · Oracle Database · TypeScript · Spring Boot

positions.title: MES Engineer (Client: Hyundai Mobis)
positions.description:
Contract MES engineer at Hyundai Mobis's automotive parts plant through Brainer Consultancy.
• Supported MES (factory production software) on a live automotive production line, fixing software and integration issues to keep production running.
• Investigated software and cross-system problems during production incidents to minimize line downtime.
• Worked with IT, production, and quality teams to turn shop-floor requests into system improvements.
• Learned how manufacturing data moves through a plant, which I later applied to logistics system development.

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained 4+ web applications using PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and JavaScript, including an event management system for tracking student participation.
• Migrated authentication from CAS to SAML in PHP/Laravel and implemented role-based access control.
• Tuned MySQL database performance (via phpMyAdmin) to improve application responsiveness.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · MySQL · JavaScript · HTML

positions.title: Software Developer Intern (Full-Stack)
positions.description:
• Developed a React web app that automatically generates video subtitles using machine learning on AWS.
• Implemented user authentication for the React web app and its Chrome extension with AWS Cognito and Amplify.
• Built Stripe subscription billing on AWS Lambda that syncs each user’s subscription status to Amazon RDS.

projects.title: Jay Asset — Tactical Asset Allocation Web App
projects.description:
Live at asset.jehyeonlee.net
• Built and deployed a full-stack web app (React, MUI, Flask) that calculates monthly portfolio allocations for five tactical asset-allocation strategies (PAA, VAA, DAA, CDM, momentum) across 22 ETFs, with English/Korean UI.
• Designed a serverless AWS backend defined in AWS SAM: Flask on Lambda behind a Function URL, DynamoDB tables for daily prices, cached backtest performance, and TTL-based calculation cache, plus EventBridge Scheduler jobs for weekday price ingestion and monthly performance refresh.
• Improved reliability by replacing live calls to free price sources with a Tiingo ingestion pipeline into DynamoDB (self-healing 14-day lookback), and debugged a Lambda Function URL failure caused by a string statusCode in the WSGI adapter response.

projects.title: AI-Driven Stock Trading System
projects.description:
·	Developed an AI-powered trading system using Deep Q-Networks (DQN) and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)
models for real-time stock trading.
·	Built a data pipeline to continuously retrieve and store financial data, enabling ongoing model training and market adaptation using SQL and Python.
·	Enhanced trading strategies with real-time AI training and backtesting against historical data.
